name: NEWSdm
full_name: Nuclear Emulsions for WIMP Search – directional measurement
summary: NEWSdm records extremely short recoil tracks in ultrahigh-resolution nuclear emulsions to develop directional direct dark-matter detection. It also studies surface deployment for cosmic-ray-boosted dark matter.
detection_principle: Particles leave latent tracks in silver-halide nanocrystal emulsions. Development and optical scanning reconstruct directions; an equatorial mount can maintain the target's orientation relative to the Galaxy.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
